model.title: Redraft: 'The writer shows Khalid is loyal, he serves under Abu Ubaydah. This shows he was loyal.'

parts.text: // comma splice: The writer shows Khalid is loyal; he serves under Abu Ubaydah.
R repetition: 'This shows he was loyal' becomes 'This acceptance of a lower rank'
T tense: present for analysis: presents, suggests
Precision: 'reveals that his service was for Allah, not status'

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: The writer presents Khalid as loyal; he serves under Abu Ubaydah without complaint. This acceptance of a lower rank reveals that his service was for Allah, not status.

panels.title: Tense rule for analysis
points: Events: past tense (Umar set the calendar)

keywords.def: two sentences wrongly joined with only a comma

questions.q: Fix: Umar became caliph, he lived simply.
questions.a: Umar became caliph; he lived simply. (or ...caliph, yet he lived simply.)

questions.q: Core: code and redraft one portfolio paragraph, then rewrite it cleanly
questions.a: A polished paragraph with visible edits

questions.q: Extend: write two sentences explaining your two most important improvements
Stretch: add one semi-colon and one parenthesis correctly
Which correctly fixes 'Ali was banned, he did not give up.'?
options: Ali was banned he did not give up.
Ali was banned, he, did not give up.
Ali was banned, but he did not give up.
questions.a: C) Ali was banned, but he did not give up.. Adding the conjunction 'but' correctly joins the two clauses.
